2.answer:
Nowadays, many Vietnamese families use the long Lunar New Year break to go on holiday or go back to their hometowns. As a result, roads, airports and tourist places are extremely busy at this time of year. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, travelling during Tet has one main advantage. The biggest benefit is that people have a long holiday to relax and spend time with their loved ones. Most offices and schools close for about a week, so the whole family can travel together. For example, my family sometimes flies to Da Nang on the second day of Tet and enjoys the beach for four days. Therefore, we can rest after a busy year and create happy memories together.

On the other hand, travelling during Tet brings two serious problems. Firstly, travel costs are much higher than usual. This is because airlines, bus companies and hotels raise their prices when demand is very high. For instance, a plane ticket from Ho Chi Minh City to Hanoi is often much more expensive than in normal months. Secondly, tourist places are very crowded, while many services are closed. Popular sites are full of visitors, but many local shops and restaurants close for several days. A good example is Da Lat, where tourists often sit in traffic jams for hours and struggle to find an open restaurant. As a result, a trip can become tiring and stressful instead of relaxing.

In conclusion, travelling during Tet has both advantages and disadvantages. It gives families a long break to relax together, but trips can be expensive, crowded and tiring. Therefore, travellers should book early and choose less popular places.

I think responsibilities should be divided according to each person's time and ability. This is because everyone has a different schedule and different skills. For example, in my family, the person who comes home first cooks, and the others wash the dishes.
I usually spend my money on food, books and coffee with friends. The main reason is that these things make my daily life enjoyable. I also save some money every month for a trip with my family.

Yes, I think having more money can make me a little happier. This is because money helps us pay for basic needs and reduces our worries. However, a bigger salary cannot buy good health or true friends.

I think relationships matter more for happiness than money. The main reason is that family and friends support us when we have problems. For example, when I failed an important exam at medical school, my parents' kind words helped me much more than money.

The first reason is that people work harder when they enjoy their job. By that, I mean they do not feel bored, so they want to learn more every day. For example, my cousin loves drawing, so a job as a graphic designer would keep her motivated for many years.

Another reason is that interest leads to success and a good income later. In other words, when people are good at their work, their salary usually goes up. For instance, my friend started with a low salary at a small IT company. Because he loved coding, he improved quickly and got a promotion after two years.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding a job with a high salary, I do not think it is the best choice because money cannot make a boring job enjoyable for long. 3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of failure. In my opinion, failure is painful, but it can help us grow.

Firstly, failure teaches valuable and memorable lessons. When we fail, we see our mistakes clearly and remember them for a long time. For example, I failed my first driving test because I forgot to check the mirror, and I have never made that mistake again.

Secondly, failure motivates people to work harder. After a bad result, many people want to prove that they can do better. For instance, my cousin failed his university entrance exam, so he studied every day for a year and passed the next time.

Thirdly, failure improves our problem-solving skills. We have to find out what went wrong and try a different way. A good example is my research team, whose first AI model gave wrong results, so we changed the data and fixed the problem.

Another important point is that failure makes us stronger and more patient. We learn that a bad day does not last forever. For example, after several of my research papers were rejected, I learned to stay calm and keep trying.

To sum up, failure has many benefits because it teaches us lessons, motivates us, improves our problem-solving skills and makes us stronger.
3.own_idea: Failure makes us stronger and more patient
follow_ups: Yes, I think people often learn more from failure than from success. The main reason is that failure makes us stop and think about our mistakes. For example, when a project goes well, we just celebrate, but when it fails, we discuss every step carefully.

Parents should stay calm and support their children when they fail. The main reason is that children already feel sad, so blaming them only makes things worse. For example, parents can talk with their child about what went wrong and help him make a better plan.

Yes, I think too much failure can discourage a person. The main reason is that people may start to believe they are not good enough. For example, a student who fails many tests in a row may give up, so teachers should set small goals that he can reach.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many parents complain about classroom problems on Facebook and Zalo rather than talking to teachers. These posts often show only the parents' side and make teachers stressed. This essay will discuss the main causes of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main causes of this trend. Firstly, social media is fast and easy to use, so parents share their anger immediately. They also hope others will support them and put pressure on the school. For example, a mother may post a photo of her child's low mark and ask for comments. As a result, a small problem becomes a public argument. Secondly, many parents find it difficult to communicate with teachers directly. Some teachers are too busy to reply, and some schools have no clear way to receive complaints. For instance, a father may call the school many times but never get a clear answer. Therefore, he feels ignored and writes about it online.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, schools and the local media should teach parents to use social media responsibly. They can explain that one-sided posts may hurt teachers and even children. A good example is a short talk at the start of the school year about checking facts before posting. Secondly, schools should create quick and friendly channels for parents. Each class can have an official online group, and the class teacher can meet parents once a month. For example, a school can promise to answer complaints within two days. Thanks to this, parents will feel heard and stop posting online.

In conclusion, parents post one-sided opinions online mainly because social media is easy to use and talking to schools is often difficult. However, this can be reduced if parents use social media responsibly and schools communicate better.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of travelling. In my opinion, travelling is one of the best ways to learn and enjoy life.

Firstly, travelling broadens our knowledge and understanding of other cultures. When we visit a new place, we can see how local people live, eat and celebrate. For example, when I visited Japan, I learned that people there take off their shoes before entering a house.

Secondly, travelling helps reduce stress and improve our mental well-being. A trip takes us away from work, deadlines and noisy traffic. For instance, after a weekend at the beach in Phan Thiet, I always feel calm and full of energy.

Thirdly, travelling creates opportunities to meet new people. We can talk to local people and other travellers, and some of them may become our friends. A good example is a Korean couple I met at a homestay in Sa Pa, and we still message each other.

Another important point is that travelling teaches us practical life skills. We have to plan our budget, read maps and solve problems on our own. For example, when I missed a train in Thailand, I had to find another way to get to my hotel.

To sum up, travelling has many benefits because it broadens our knowledge, reduces stress, helps us meet new people and teaches us life skills.
follow_ups: Yes, I think young people today travel more than in the past. The main reason is that flights are cheaper and travel information is easy to find online. For example, my younger cousin has visited five countries, while my parents first went abroad in their fifties.

Travelling too often can be expensive and tiring. The main reason is that people spend a lot of money on tickets and hotels, and they may not get enough rest. For example, a friend of mine travels almost every weekend, so she often feels exhausted at work on Mondays.

Technology has made travelling much easier and cheaper. The main reason is that we can book flights, hotels and taxis on our phones in a few minutes. For example, I used Google Maps and a translation app to find my way around Tokyo without a tour guide.

2.answer:
Today, some parents complain about school problems on Facebook instead of talking to teachers first. These posts often tell only one side of the story, and they put great stress on teachers. This essay will discuss the main problems of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main problems of this trend for teachers. Firstly, teachers feel great stress and may lose their good name. A one-sided post spreads quickly, and people judge the teacher without knowing the full story. For example, a parent may write that a teacher was unfair, although the child had broken a class rule. As a result, the teacher may receive angry comments and feel afraid to go to work. Secondly, trust between teachers and parents is damaged. Teachers become very careful, so they avoid giving honest feedback about students. For instance, a teacher may stop telling parents about a child's bad behaviour because she fears online attacks. Therefore, problems stay unsolved, and students suffer.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, schools should create clear and fast ways for parents to contact teachers. They can set up an official online group where teachers reply within a day. A good example is a monthly parent-teacher meeting where both sides can discuss problems face to face. Secondly, parents should talk to teachers directly before they post anything online. Schools can run short workshops to show parents how to use social media responsibly. For example, a workshop can explain how one angry post may hurt a teacher's career. Thanks to this, both sides can solve problems calmly.

In conclusion, one-sided posts by parents put teachers under great stress and damage trust between home and school. However, this can be reduced if schools offer better communication channels and parents talk to teachers first.

Today I would like to talk about the advantages of hiring housemaids. In my opinion, a housemaid can make life much easier for busy families.

Firstly, a housemaid can keep the house cleaner and tidier. She has time to clean every room, wash the clothes and take out the rubbish every day. For example, my aunt works long hours, but her house always looks neat because her housemaid cleans it carefully.

Secondly, people have more opportunities to socialise. Instead of doing housework all weekend, they can meet friends and visit relatives. For instance, since my cousin hired a housemaid, she has joined a book club and meets her friends every Sunday.

Thirdly, people have more time to relax after work. They can read, exercise or simply rest, so they feel less stressed. A good example is my colleague, who now goes swimming in the evening instead of cooking and washing dishes.

Another important point is that a housemaid can help to look after children and elderly people. Many young parents are very busy, and their own parents may need care at home. For example, my neighbour's housemaid takes her son to school and reminds her grandmother to take her medicine.

To sum up, hiring a housemaid has many benefits because of a cleaner home, a better social life, more free time and extra care.

2.answer:
In recent years, burgers, fried chicken and pizza have become a common meal for both children and adults. Many people now eat these meals several times a week, and this habit harms their health. This essay will discuss the main causes of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main causes of eating too much fast food. Firstly, many people have a busy lifestyle and little time to cook. Fast food is ready in a few minutes, so it is an easy choice after a long day. For example, an office worker may buy fried chicken on the way home because she is too tired to cook. As a result, fast food becomes her usual dinner. Secondly, fast food is cheap and heavily advertised. Delivery apps often offer discounts, and colourful advertisements are everywhere online. For instance, a student may see a "buy one, get one free" offer for pizza and order it at once. Therefore, many young people eat fast food more often than they should.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, companies and schools should offer cheap and healthy meals. They can open canteens that serve rice, vegetables and fish at a low price. A good example is a hospital canteen where doctors can get a healthy lunch in five minutes. Secondly, the government should control fast food advertising, especially for children. It can ban these advertisements near schools and limit discounts on delivery apps. For example, fast food posters should not appear at school gates. Thanks to this, people will see fewer temptations and choose healthier food.

In conclusion, eating too much fast food is mainly caused by busy lifestyles and cheap, attractive offers. However, it can be reduced if companies and schools provide healthy meals and the government controls advertising.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of learning a new language. In my opinion, a new language opens many doors in our lives.

Firstly, learning a new language helps us make new friends. We can talk with people from other countries and understand them better. For example, I made friends with two Australian doctors at a conference because I could speak English.

Secondly, a new language helps us learn about the culture of other countries. When we read books or watch films in that language, we understand people's customs and ideas better. For instance, I learned a lot about British life by watching English TV series with subtitles.

Thirdly, it makes communicating while travelling much easier. Travellers can ask for directions, order food and solve problems by themselves. A good example is my trip to Singapore, where I used English to find my hotel and buy train tickets.

Another important point is that a new language can bring better job opportunities. Many companies want staff who can speak English or another foreign language. For example, in my research team, people with good English can read new medical studies and join international projects.

To sum up, learning a new language has many benefits because of new friendships, cultural knowledge, easier travel and better jobs. I think everyone should try to learn at least one foreign language.
follow_ups: Yes, I think learning a language early has a good effect on children. The main reason is that young children can copy sounds and accents very easily. For example, my niece started learning English at the age of five, and now her pronunciation is much better than mine.

I think some people learn faster because they practise more and are not afraid of making mistakes. The main reason is that speaking a lot helps the brain remember new words. For example, my colleague talks with foreign tourists every weekend, so her English improves very quickly.

Yes, I think grammar is important, but it is not the most important thing. The main reason is that we need grammar to make our meaning clear. For example, if we use the wrong tense, people may not know whether something happened yesterday or will happen tomorrow.

2.answer:
Today, many young people wonder whether a university degree is really necessary. People have different opinions on whether a good education or personal qualities matter more for success in life. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that education is still the key to a better future.

On the one hand, some people believe that success depends mainly on personal qualities and experience. This is because skills such as hard work, patience and communication are not always taught at school. For example, many successful business owners in Vietnam started with small shops and never went to university. They learnt how to run a business through years of practice. As a result, these people think that determination is more valuable than a degree.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that education leads to a better life. Firstly, education gives people the knowledge needed for many important jobs. Nobody can become a doctor, an engineer or a lawyer without years of formal study. For instance, I studied medicine for six years before I could understand how diseases develop. Secondly, education also helps people build good personal qualities. At school and university, students learn to manage their time, work in teams and keep trying. A good example is a student who prepares for a difficult exam for months and learns to be patient. Therefore, education and personal qualities are closely connected.

In conclusion, although personal qualities and experience are important, I believe that education is the key to success because it provides essential knowledge and helps people develop good qualities. Young people should value their studies and also look for practical experience.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the importance of good behaviour. In my opinion, good behaviour is one of the most valuable qualities a person can have.

Firstly, good behaviour helps us build positive relationships with others. When we are polite, honest and kind, people trust us and like to be around us. For example, my neighbour always greets everyone with a smile, so the whole street respects her.

Secondly, good behaviour creates a better school and working environment. If everyone respects each other, there are fewer arguments and people feel safe. For instance, in my research team, we always listen to each other's ideas, so working together is pleasant.

Thirdly, good behaviour helps people succeed in life and work. Employers want staff who are responsible and easy to work with. A good example is my friend, who got a promotion partly because she was always on time and helpful.

Another important point is that people with good behaviour set a good example for others. Children often copy the adults around them. For example, if parents say thank you and sorry, their children will learn to do the same.

To sum up, good behaviour is important because of better relationships, a better environment, success at work and good examples for the next generation.
3.own_idea: Setting a good example for others
follow_ups: Good behaviour is important because it helps people live together peacefully. When people follow rules and respect others, society becomes safer. For example, if drivers stop at red lights and wait patiently, there are fewer accidents. Good behaviour also makes daily life more pleasant.

Many factors influence people's behaviour, but family is the most important one. Children learn manners from their parents first. Friends, school and social media also play a big role. For example, teenagers often copy what they see on TikTok, both good and bad.

Yes, I think schools can help students develop good behaviour. Teachers can teach good manners and be good role models. For example, many schools in Vietnam have life skills lessons and organise volunteer activities. Students also learn to respect others when they work in groups.

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more young adults have decided not to marry or have children. This lifestyle is now common in many countries, including Vietnam. This essay will discuss the main causes of this trend and its effects.

There are two main causes of staying single. Firstly, many young people focus on their education and careers. They want a good job and a stable income before they think about marriage. For example, many of my colleagues are over thirty and still single because they are busy with their master's or PhD studies. Secondly, the cost of living in big cities is very high. Buying a house and raising children require a lot of money. For instance, a young couple in Ho Chi Minh City may find it hard to pay for rent, school fees and health care. Therefore, many people feel that staying single is a safer choice.

This trend has two important effects. The first effect is that single people enjoy more freedom. They can decide how to spend their time and money without asking anyone. A good example is my friend Hoa, who travels to a new country every year and takes evening classes. Another effect is that single people can invest more in themselves. They have more time to learn new skills, look after their health and build their careers. For example, a single nurse may use her free evenings to take an English course. As a result, many of them become more confident and successful at work.

In conclusion, staying single is mainly caused by career goals and high living costs, and it leads to more freedom and self-development. These are the main advantages for people who choose this lifestyle.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of extracurricular activities for children. In my opinion, these activities are as important as lessons in class.

Firstly, extracurricular activities help children develop social connections. They meet children from other classes and work together towards the same goal. For example, my nephew joined a school football team and made many new friends there.

Secondly, these activities improve children's physical and mental health. Sports keep their bodies strong, while art and music help them relax after school. For instance, as someone who studied medicine, I know that active children usually sleep better and feel less stressed.

Thirdly, children learn important life skills. They learn how to manage time, solve problems and work in a team. A good example is a school camping trip, where children have to set up tents and cook together.

Another important point is that extracurricular activities help children discover their talents and interests. Many children do not know what they are good at until they try new things. For example, my niece found out that she loves drawing after she joined an art club. Now she wants to become a designer.

To sum up, extracurricular activities are very useful for children because of social connections, better health, life skills and new talents.
follow_ups: No, I do not think schools should force all children to join. The main reason is that some children already have a lot of homework or need rest. For example, a shy child may feel stressed if she must join a drama club. Schools should offer many choices and encourage children instead.

Parents can encourage their children by letting them choose activities they really like. They should also praise their children's efforts, not only the results. For example, my sister always watches my nephew's football matches at weekends. This makes him feel proud and want to continue.

I think swimming is the most beneficial activity for children. The main reason is that it keeps them healthy and can save their lives. For example, Vietnam has many rivers and beaches, so knowing how to swim is very important. It is also a fun activity for the whole family.

2.answer:
Nowadays, being able to speak another language is more and more necessary at school and at work. Many people think that it brings new chances, especially in technology and in personal experience. This essay will discuss the main reasons for this.

To begin with, learning languages helps technology develop in two ways. Firstly, most new research is written in English. People who read English well can learn about new tools as soon as they appear. For example, I read English papers about AI in medicine every week, and many are never translated into Vietnamese. Secondly, language skills help engineers work with foreign partners. This is because big technology projects often need teams from different countries. For instance, a Vietnamese software company may work with clients in Japan or Korea. As a result, workers who speak foreign languages can share ideas and build better products.

In addition, learning languages also helps people gain experience. One important point is that it allows them to study or work abroad. They can live in a new culture and learn new ways of thinking. A good example is my friend Lan, who studied nursing in Australia and now trains young nurses here. Another point is that language skills make travel more meaningful. Travellers can talk to local people instead of only taking photos. For example, a tourist who speaks some Thai can ask locals about their food and festivals. Thanks to this, they understand the world better and become more open-minded.

In conclusion, learning foreign languages is useful for both technology and personal experience. It helps people follow new research and work in international teams. It also gives them chances to study, work and travel abroad.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of reading e-books. In my opinion, e-books make reading easier for everyone.

Firstly, e-books save time and provide convenient access to books. People can buy and download a book in a few seconds without going to a bookshop. For example, I can carry hundreds of books on my phone and read them on the bus.

Secondly, e-books help reduce cost and protect the environment. They are usually cheaper than paper books, and many classic books are free. For instance, no trees are cut down to make an e-book, and no trucks are needed to deliver it.

Thirdly, e-books support flexible learning and reading habits. Readers can read anywhere and at any time, even for just five minutes. A good example is my habit of reading a few pages of a medical e-book during my lunch break.

Another important point is that e-books have helpful reading features. Readers can change the font size, look up new words and search for information quickly. For example, my father has weak eyes, so he makes the text bigger on his tablet.

To sum up, reading e-books has many benefits because of convenience, low cost, flexibility and helpful features.
follow_ups: The main disadvantage of e-books is that they can hurt our eyes. Looking at a screen for a long time makes our eyes tired and dry. For example, after reading on my phone for an hour, I often get a headache. Also, notifications can easily distract readers.

No, I do not think e-books will replace paper books completely. The main reason is that many people still love the feel and smell of real books. For example, my friends and I still buy paper books as gifts. However, e-books will become more and more popular.

Yes, e-books are becoming popular in Vietnam, especially among young people. The main reason is that almost everyone has a smartphone now. For example, many students use apps like Waka to read novels and study materials. However, many older people still prefer paper books.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many people take their laptops to coffee shops, libraries and co-working spaces instead of working at the office or at home. This way of working offers a fresh atmosphere. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, working in public spaces has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that these places are often noisy and not private. This is because many strangers talk, make phone calls and walk around all the time. For example, a person who joins an online meeting in a busy coffee shop may not hear his colleagues clearly. As a result, he may lose focus, and other people might even see private information on his screen.

On the other hand, working in public spaces brings two important benefits. Firstly, a new environment can make people more creative and motivated. When they leave home, they avoid distractions such as housework or a comfortable bed. For instance, I often write my research reports in a quiet coffee shop on Saturday mornings, and I work much faster there. Secondly, public spaces give people a chance to meet others. In other words, freelancers and small business owners can build useful relationships. A good example is a co-working space, where a designer may meet a new client at the coffee machine. Thanks to this, workers feel less lonely and may find new opportunities.

In conclusion, working in public spaces has both advantages and disadvantages. Noise and a lack of privacy can be a problem, but these places can make people more creative and help them build relationships. Workers should choose a place that suits the type of task they have.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the role of technology in the workplace. In my opinion, technology has changed the way we work in many positive ways.

Firstly, technology improves productivity and work efficiency. Computers and software can do boring tasks quickly and with fewer mistakes. For example, at my university, we use software to sort thousands of patient records in a few minutes instead of several days.

Secondly, technology supports communication and teamwork. Colleagues can talk, share files and work on the same document from different places. For instance, my team often has online meetings on Zoom with doctors in Da Nang and Hanoi, so nobody needs to travel.

Thirdly, technology creates new ways of working and career opportunities. Many people can now work from home or become freelancers. A good example is the job of app developer, which did not exist thirty years ago.

Another important point is that technology helps workers make better decisions. Smart tools can find patterns in large amounts of data. For example, an AI tool can help doctors find signs of disease on an X-ray image.

To sum up, technology plays an important role in the workplace because of higher productivity, better teamwork, new career opportunities and smarter decisions.
follow_ups: Technology has changed work in many ways. People now use computers and phones for almost every task, and they can work from anywhere. For example, my father used to write reports by hand, but now I type and send everything online. Meetings can also happen on video calls.

The main disadvantage is that people may depend too much on technology. When the Internet or the system breaks down, work stops. For example, last month a partner hospital's computer system went down for two hours, so doctors had to write by hand. Technology can also make people work longer hours.

No, I do not think technology will replace all human workers. The main reason is that many jobs need creativity, care and human feelings. For example, AI can read X-rays, but patients still need a doctor to explain the results and comfort them. However, some simple jobs may disappear.

2.answer:
Nowadays, more and more people are moving from the countryside to big cities, and many villages are turning into towns. This change has both good and bad sides for society. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, urbanization has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that cities become too crowded and polluted. This is because millions of people live, work and travel in a small area, and there is not enough public transport. For example, in Ho Chi Minh City, the roads are full of motorbikes at rush hour, and the air is often dirty. As a result, people waste a lot of time in traffic, and many suffer from breathing problems.

On the other hand, urbanization brings two important benefits. Firstly, it creates more jobs and higher incomes. Factories, offices and shops in cities need a lot of workers, and they usually pay more than farms. For instance, many young people from the Mekong Delta move to industrial parks near big cities and send money home to their families. Secondly, city people have better access to health care and education. This means that they can find good doctors and good schools more easily. A good example is a big city hospital, which has modern machines and specialist doctors that small towns often do not have. Thanks to this, people in cities can get better treatment when they are ill.

In conclusion, urbanization has both advantages and disadvantages. It can make cities crowded and polluted, but it also brings more jobs and better services. Therefore, governments should plan cities carefully so that everyone can enjoy the benefits.

Today I would like to talk about the factors to consider when choosing a job. In my opinion, a good job is not only about money.

Firstly, salary and financial benefits are very important. Everyone needs money to pay for rent, food and their family's needs. For example, a job with health insurance and a yearly bonus can make workers feel secure.

Secondly, people should think about the working environment and company culture. If colleagues are friendly and managers are fair, people enjoy going to work every day. For instance, I chose my current job partly because the people in my team often help each other and share ideas.

Thirdly, career development opportunities matter a lot, especially for young people. A good company offers training courses and a clear path to promotion. A good example is my friend, who works for a bank that pays for her master's degree.

Another important point is that people should look for work-life balance. If a job takes all their time, they will feel tired and stressed. For example, I studied medicine, so I know that long working hours can harm both the body and the mind.

To sum up, when choosing a job, people should consider salary, the working environment, career development and work-life balance.
follow_ups: Young people today have different expectations because they have more choices than before. They can work online, start a business or work for foreign companies. For example, many of my younger cousins care more about flexible hours than a high salary. They also want meaningful work.

No, I do not think salary is more important than job satisfaction. The main reason is that we spend most of our day at work. For example, a friend of mine left a well-paid job because he felt stressed every day. Now he earns less, but he enjoys his work.

Companies can attract young employees in several ways. They should offer fair salaries, flexible working hours and chances to learn new skills. For example, some technology companies let staff work from home two days a week. A friendly and modern office also makes young people want to stay.

2.answer:
Nowadays, thanks to modern technology and fast Internet access, more and more people take courses on their computers and phones. Many students like this way of studying, but others still prefer real classrooms. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, online learning has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that students have less contact with teachers and classmates. This is because they only see each other on a screen, so it is hard to ask questions and work in groups. For example, during the COVID-19 pandemic, many pupils turned off their cameras and did not join class discussions. As a result, some of them felt lonely and lost interest in their studies.

On the other hand, online learning brings two important benefits. Firstly, it is very flexible. Learners can study at any time and in any place, as long as they have an Internet connection. For instance, I took an online course about AI in medicine in the evenings, so I did not have to leave my job. Secondly, online courses are often cheaper than traditional ones. The reason is that students do not need to pay for travel or rent a room in the city. A good example is a student in a village in Dak Lak who can join English lessons with a teacher in Ho Chi Minh City. Thanks to this, more people can get a good education.

In conclusion, online learning has both advantages and disadvantages. It may reduce contact between people, but it is flexible and cheaper than traditional classes. Therefore, students should combine online lessons with some face-to-face activities.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of attending workshops. In my opinion, workshops are a great way to learn and grow.

Firstly, workshops help people learn new knowledge and practical skills. Unlike long courses, they focus on one useful topic and give people a chance to practise. For example, last month I joined a one-day workshop on AI tools for medical images, and I used them at work the next day.

Secondly, workshops are a good place for meeting new people and expanding networks. Participants often come from different companies and universities. For instance, at a workshop in Da Nang, I met two doctors who later joined one of our research projects.

Thirdly, workshops help with improving confidence and personal development. People usually have to work in groups, ask questions or present their ideas. A good example is my colleague, who was very shy before, but now she speaks confidently after several workshops.

Another important point is that workshops help people keep up with the latest trends. Speakers are often experts who share new ideas and research. For example, I learnt about some new health apps at a technology workshop last year.

To sum up, attending workshops is very useful because of new skills, wider networks, more confidence and up-to-date knowledge.

2.answer:
Today, arguments between parents and their children happen in many homes. Some people think the main reason is that parents still see their children as small kids and do not trust their choices. This essay will discuss the main causes of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main causes of these conflicts. Firstly, I agree that many parents do not trust their children enough. They want to protect their children, so they make important decisions for them. For example, some parents choose their child's university major without asking what he really likes. As a result, the child feels angry and controlled. Secondly, there is a big generation gap, and families do not talk enough. This means that parents and children have different values, but they rarely share their thoughts. For instance, a busy father may only talk to his daughter about her exam results. Therefore, small disagreements about clothes, friends or phones easily turn into big arguments.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, parents should give their children more freedom step by step. They can let their teenagers make small decisions first and then bigger ones. A good example is allowing a son to manage his own pocket money for a month. Secondly, families should spend regular time talking and listening to each other. Parents and children can have dinner together without phones and share their feelings honestly. Thanks to this, they will understand and respect each other more.

In conclusion, conflicts between parents and children are mainly caused by parents' lack of trust and poor communication. However, they can be reduced if parents give more freedom step by step and families talk openly every day.

Today I would like to talk about how to make a person successful and responsible. In my opinion, success and responsibility come from good habits and the right education.

Firstly, there are several qualities that help people become successful. Hard work, patience and a positive attitude are the most important ones. For example, many top students study a little every day instead of only before exams.

Secondly, there are clear reasons why responsible people are respected. They keep their promises and accept their mistakes, so others can trust them. For instance, a doctor who checks every detail carefully earns the trust of patients and colleagues.

Thirdly, there are some solutions to develop responsibility in students. Schools can give them group projects, and parents can give them simple jobs at home. A good example is asking children to clean their rooms and take care of a plant.

Another important point is that people should learn from failure. Successful people do not give up after a mistake but try to improve. For example, I failed my first research project, but I learned a lot and did much better the next time.

To sum up, people become successful and responsible thanks to good qualities, trustworthy behaviour, good training and learning from failure.
follow_ups: A person is considered responsible when they do what they promise. They finish their work on time and accept the results of their actions. For example, a responsible colleague tells the team immediately when he makes a mistake. People trust him because he is honest and reliable.

I think practical lessons are the best way to teach responsibility. For example, students can take care of the school garden or organise a class event. They can also do volunteer work in their community. These activities show them that their actions affect other people.

In my opinion, the most necessary qualities are hard work and the ability to learn quickly. The main reason is that the world changes very fast today. For example, many workers must learn to use AI tools in their jobs. Good communication is also important for teamwork.

2.answer:
In recent years, quick and cheap meals such as burgers and fried chicken have become part of daily life for many people. However, eating them too often can damage our health. This essay will discuss the main problems of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main problems caused by eating too much fast food. Firstly, it can lead to obesity and serious diseases. Fast food usually contains a lot of fat, salt and sugar but few vitamins. For example, a large combo meal with a soft drink may have more calories than an adult needs for lunch and dinner together. As a result, regular customers have a higher risk of diabetes and heart disease. Secondly, fast food creates unhealthy eating habits, especially in children. This means that children who often eat fast food may refuse vegetables and home-cooked meals. For instance, some children cry for fried chicken every weekend and do not want to eat rice and fish at home.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, governments should help people make healthier choices. They can require fast food restaurants to show clear calorie information on their menus. They can also limit fast food advertisements on children's TV programmes. Secondly, schools and parents should teach children how to eat well. A good example is a school that serves balanced lunches and teaches pupils to read food labels. Parents can also cook simple, healthy meals with their children at weekends. Thanks to this, children will learn to enjoy fast food only as an occasional treat.

In conclusion, eating too much fast food can cause obesity, diseases and bad eating habits. However, these problems can be reduced if governments give clear information and schools and parents teach children to eat healthily.

The first reason is that a water park is suitable for every member of my family. By that, I mean there are activities for both adults and children. For example, my little nephew can play in the shallow pool, while my parents can relax in the lazy river.

Another reason is that it is a great way to stay cool and healthy. In other words, the weather in Ho Chi Minh City is very hot, so playing in the water is refreshing. For instance, my family and I love swimming, and we can spend the whole day in the pools and on the slides.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding visiting an amusement park, I do not think it is the best choice because many rides are too scary for my parents. The tickets are also expensive, and people often wait in long queues. As for visiting a museum, I do not think it is the best option either because my nephew would get bored quickly. A museum is better for a short visit, not a whole family day.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe going to a water park is the best choice because it is fun, healthy and suitable for everyone.

Today I would like to talk about the disadvantages of living in an apartment. In my opinion, apartments are convenient, but they also have some serious problems.

Firstly, the living space in apartments is often limited. Many apartments have only one or two small bedrooms, so big families feel crowded. For example, my friend's family of five lives in a small apartment, and his children have to share one room.

Secondly, there are often problems related to neighbours. People live very close to each other, so noise can easily cause conflicts. For instance, my neighbour sometimes sings karaoke late at night, and I cannot sleep.

Thirdly, it is difficult to keep pets in apartments. Many buildings do not allow dogs, and there is no garden for pets to run around. A good example is my colleague, who had to give his dog to his parents after he moved into an apartment.

Another important point is that apartment owners have to pay monthly service fees. These fees pay for security, cleaning and lifts. For example, my friend pays a few hundred thousand dong every month, even when his family is away.

To sum up, living in an apartment has several disadvantages because of limited space, problems with neighbours, difficulties with pets and extra fees.

I think people need to plan early if they want to live in their dream places in fifty years. They should save money and choose cities with good jobs and clean environments. Governments should also build more affordable homes and green cities for the future.

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for your email. I am happy to answer your questions about my gap year in Australia.

Regarding skills, you should improve your English before you go, especially listening and speaking. You will also need basic life skills, such as cooking, washing clothes and managing money. When I arrived in Melbourne, I could not cook at all, so I spent too much on takeaway food.

As for making the most of your time, you should set clear goals before you leave. For example, decide which places you want to visit and which skills you want to learn. I volunteered at a health centre for three months, and it was the best part. Try not to waste time in your room on your phone.

About your question on your studies, you should keep learning a little every week. Reading short articles in your subject will keep your knowledge fresh. You should also apply to your university early and write down your experiences for your application.

That's all for now. Write back soon!

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
In recent years, the air in many large cities has become very dirty and unsafe to breathe. This harms people's health, daily life and the natural world. This essay will discuss the main causes of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main causes of air pollution. Firstly, there are too many private vehicles on the roads. Millions of motorbikes and cars release smoke every day, especially during rush hour. For example, the air in big cities such as Hanoi is often grey and smoky in the early morning. Secondly, many factories and building sites produce a lot of dust and harmful gases. Some factories burn coal and do not clean their smoke before it goes into the air. As a result, people living nearby often suffer from coughs, asthma and other breathing problems.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, governments should invest more in clean public transport. They can build more metro lines and use electric buses instead of old diesel ones. For instance, the new metro line in Ho Chi Minh City helps many people leave their motorbikes at home. Secondly, local authorities should make stricter rules for factories and construction companies. Factories should use filters, and building sites should be covered and watered to reduce dust. A good example is a heavy fine for any company that pollutes the air. Thanks to this, the air will become cleaner and people will be healthier.

In conclusion, air pollution is mainly caused by too many private vehicles and dirty factories and building sites. However, it can be reduced if governments develop clean public transport and local authorities control factories more strictly.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of group travelling for students. In my opinion, travelling in a group is a cheap, safe and fun way for students to explore new places.

Firstly, there are several reasons why students choose group travelling. Many students do not have much money or travel experience, so they feel more comfortable with friends. For example, my classmates and I went to Da Lat together after our final exams.

Secondly, group travelling brings two clear benefits: safety and saving money. When students travel together, they can look after each other if someone gets lost or sick. For instance, a group of six can share a homestay, a car and meals, so each person pays much less.

Thirdly, group travelling improves relationships and experiences. Students spend days together, so they understand each other better and become closer friends. A good example is a class trip to the beach, where students cook, play games and sing together at night.

Another important point is that group trips teach students teamwork skills. They have to plan the schedule, divide tasks and agree on decisions. For example, one person books the hotel while another manages the shared money.

To sum up, group travelling is good for students because it is safe and cheap, it builds friendships and it develops teamwork skills.
3.own_idea: Group trips teach students teamwork skills
follow_ups: Travelling in a group also has some disadvantages. The biggest problem is that people may have different plans and interests. For example, some friends want to go shopping, while others want to visit museums. As a result, the group may argue and waste time making decisions.

Many students prefer travelling with friends because it is more fun and less lonely. They can share funny moments and take photos together. In addition, travelling with friends is cheaper, because they can share the costs of rooms and transport.

Students should make a clear plan before the trip. Firstly, they should agree on the budget, the places to visit and the schedule. Secondly, they should divide the tasks. For example, one person books tickets, another finds a homestay and another keeps the group's money.

Hi Anna,

Thank you for your email. I am happy to share my hobbies with you and give you some advice.

Regarding my free time, I usually read books or meet my friends at a coffee shop. Reading helps me relax after a busy day at work. At weekends, I also go swimming at a pool near my house.

As for my favourite hobby, swimming, I started it about five years ago. At that time, I often had back pain because I sat at my desk for too long. A doctor friend advised me to swim, so I joined a beginners' class. After a few months, I could swim well and my back felt much better.

About your question on starting a new hobby, I have three simple tips. First, choose an activity that you really enjoy, not one that is just popular. Second, start slowly and practise at a regular time each week. Finally, do it with a friend, so you will not give up easily.

2.answer:
Nowadays, how happy people feel at work has a strong influence on how hard they try and how well they perform. Many different things can make employees satisfied or unhappy with their jobs. This essay will discuss the main factors that affect job satisfaction.

To begin with, the rewards of a job affect workers in two ways. Firstly, salary is very important because people need money to support their families. When workers are paid fairly, they feel that their effort is valued. For example, a nurse who gets a good salary and bonus is more likely to stay at her hospital. Secondly, career opportunities help employees feel hopeful about the future. People want to learn new skills and get a higher position over time. As a result, workers who see no chance of promotion often look for another job.

In addition, the workplace itself also affects job satisfaction. One important point is that a good working environment makes people more comfortable and productive. This includes a clean office, modern equipment and reasonable working hours. For instance, staff in a quiet, well-equipped office can focus better than those in a noisy and crowded room. Another point is that good relationships with colleagues make work more enjoyable. Friendly co-workers help each other when there are problems. A good example is my own team, where engineers and doctors often have lunch together and share ideas. Thanks to this, we feel happy to go to work every day.

In conclusion, job satisfaction depends on both the rewards of a job and the workplace itself. A fair salary, chances for promotion, a good environment and friendly colleagues can all make employees happier and more motivated.

In this situation, among the three options, I think enrolling in an English course is the best choice for my friend. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that a course has professional teachers. By that, I mean a teacher can find my friend's mistakes in pronunciation and grammar and show him how to fix them. For example, many Vietnamese learners forget the final sounds of words, and a good teacher can correct this quickly.

Another reason is that a course gives him a clear plan and regular practice. In other words, he has to attend classes on fixed days and follow a programme from easy to difficult. For instance, he could take a ten-week speaking course with two evening classes every week.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding joining a school club, I do not think it is the best choice because club meetings are often not regular. Members also talk about many topics without a clear goal. As for practising speaking with his peers, I do not think it is the best option either because they may make the same mistakes as him. They may also switch to Vietnamese when the conversation becomes difficult.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe enrolling in an English course is the best choice because it is effective, organised and reliable.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of owning a pet. In my opinion, a pet can be a wonderful friend and a good part of the family.

Firstly, people own pets for many reasons. Some people want a friend at home, while others want their children to grow up with animals. For example, my cousin bought a cat for her son because he felt lonely after school.

Secondly, pets bring benefits for emotional and physical health. Stroking a cat or playing with a dog can make people calmer and happier. For instance, many older people who walk their dogs every day feel less lonely and stay more active.

Thirdly, pet owners have important responsibilities. They need to give their pets healthy food, clean water, regular exercise and medical care. A good example is taking a dog to the vet for vaccines every year.

Another important point is that some pets can keep our homes safe. Dogs often bark when strangers come near the house. For example, my uncle's dog in Dak Lak always warns the family when someone enters the garden at night.

To sum up, owning a pet is good for us because pets give us company, improve our health and protect our homes. In return, we must care for them responsibly.

Yes, I think pets can improve people's quality of life. The main reason is that they reduce stress and loneliness. For example, my aunt became much happier after she adopted a small dog. She also walks more, so she is healthier now.

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more teenagers and young adults feel worried and under pressure. This problem affects their school results, their jobs and their everyday happiness. This essay will discuss the main causes of this trend and its effects.

There are two main causes of stress among young people. Firstly, they face heavy pressure to succeed in study and work. Parents and teachers often expect high marks, and companies want young staff to work long hours. For example, many Vietnamese students study at extra classes until late at night before the university entrance exam. Many of them are afraid of disappointing their families. Secondly, social media makes young people compare themselves with others. They often see photos of friends with new cars, perfect bodies or exciting holidays. For instance, a young worker may feel like a failure after looking at other people's posts on Instagram.

This trend has two serious effects. The first effect is that stress makes young people study and work less well. When they feel anxious, they cannot focus or remember information easily. A good example is a student who studies all night but forgets everything in the exam the next morning. Therefore, their marks or work results often go down. Another effect is that stress harms both physical and mental health. Many stressed young people sleep badly, skip meals and stop meeting their friends. As a result, they may get headaches, stomach problems or even depression.

In conclusion, youth stress is mainly caused by pressure to succeed and social media, and it leads to poor performance and health problems. Families, schools and young people themselves should work together to reduce this pressure.

1.answer:
Hi Lan,

Thank you for your email. I am happy to answer your questions about our summer holiday.

Regarding the destination, I suggest Quy Nhon, a coastal city in central Vietnam. The beaches there are clean, quiet and very beautiful. It is also less crowded than Nha Trang, so prices are lower. I think we could go there for four days in early July.

As for activities, we can swim in the sea every morning and try snorkelling at Ky Co Beach. In the afternoon, we can rent bikes and ride along the coast. At night, we can walk around the night market and eat fresh seafood.

About your question on money, there are some easy ways to save. First, we can take the night bus from Ho Chi Minh City on Friday evening and save one night of hotel costs. Second, we can share a room in a small homestay. We should also eat at local food stalls instead of expensive restaurants.

That's all for now. Write back soon!

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
Today, the world changes so fast that many people think learning should never stop after school or university. Some say adults must keep studying all their lives, while others think a degree is enough. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that lifelong learning is necessary.

On the one hand, some people believe that formal education gives people everything they need. This is because schools and universities provide strong basic knowledge and a recognised degree. For example, a good engineering degree can help a young person find a stable job for many years. In addition, some jobs do not change much over time, so workers can use the same skills until they retire. As a result, these people think that further study is a waste of time and money.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that people should keep learning throughout their lives. Firstly, knowledge and technology change very quickly in many jobs. What we learn at university can become old after only a few years. For instance, doctors must keep reading new research to use the latest treatments and medicines. Secondly, learning new things helps people grow as individuals. It keeps their minds active and gives them more confidence. A good example is an older person who learns English online and can then talk with tourists or travel abroad alone. Therefore, lifelong learning improves both our careers and our personal lives.

In conclusion, although formal education gives people a strong start, I believe that everyone should continue learning because knowledge changes quickly and learning helps people grow. A degree should be the beginning, not the end, of our education.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the importance of travelling in people's lives. In my opinion, travelling is one of the best ways to enjoy life and learn new things.

Firstly, there are many reasons why people travel. Some people want to relax after a busy year, while others want to see new places and cultures. For example, many office workers in Ho Chi Minh City go to Da Lat to escape the heat and stress.

Secondly, travelling brings many benefits for personal development. When we travel, we have to solve problems and talk to strangers, so we become more confident and independent. For instance, my first trip alone to Hanoi taught me how to plan my money and time.

Thirdly, there are many popular travel activities and experiences. People can go swimming, climb mountains, visit museums or try local food. A good example is Hoi An, where visitors can make lanterns and take a cooking class.

Another important point is that travelling brings family and friends closer. When people share new experiences, they create happy memories together. For example, my family goes to the beach every summer, and we always talk about these trips later.

To sum up, travelling is important because it helps us relax, grow as people, enjoy new experiences and build stronger relationships.
3.own_idea: Travelling brings family and friends closer
follow_ups: I think many people enjoy travelling because life today is very busy and stressful. Travelling helps them relax and forget their work for a while. In addition, travel is easier and cheaper now. For example, people can book cheap flights and hotels on their phones in a few minutes.

Yes, I think so. The main reason is that travelling gives us new experiences that we cannot get at home. For example, we can meet new people, try new food and learn about other cultures. However, staying at home is also good when we need a quiet rest.

People can travel in a greener way by making small changes. For example, they can take trains or buses instead of planes for short trips. They should also bring their own water bottles and avoid plastic bags. Finally, they should keep beaches and forests clean.

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more parents post complaints about schools on Facebook and other platforms. However, they often tell only their side of the story before they know all the facts. This essay will discuss the main problems of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main problems caused by this trend. Firstly, it can seriously hurt teachers. When a one-sided post spreads, many people blame the teacher without knowing the truth. For example, a parent may write that a teacher punished her son unfairly, while the boy actually broke a class rule. As a result, the teacher may feel stressed and even want to leave the job. Secondly, these posts damage the trust between families and schools. This means that other parents start to doubt the school. For instance, some children may stop respecting their teachers after their parents share angry posts. Therefore, the whole learning environment becomes less friendly and less effective.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, schools should create clear and quick ways for parents to give feedback. They can use a hotline, a Zalo group or regular meetings with teachers. For instance, a parent with a complaint can meet the head teacher within two days and hear both sides. Secondly, parents should be more careful before they post anything online. Schools and the media can remind them to check the facts and think about the effects of their words. A good example is a short talk about online responsibility at every parents' meeting. Thanks to this, problems can be solved calmly.

In conclusion, one-sided posts by parents can harm teachers and damage trust in schools. However, this problem can be reduced if schools offer quick ways to give feedback and parents check the facts before posting.

Today I would like to talk about the importance of soft skills in modern life. In my opinion, soft skills are as important as knowledge for success today.

Firstly, there are many common soft skills, such as time management and problem-solving. Time management helps us finish our tasks on time, while problem-solving helps us deal with difficulties calmly. For example, I make a to-do list every morning, so I rarely miss a deadline.

Secondly, people can learn soft skills in many places. Schools, universities and companies often offer short courses and workshops. For instance, I learned presentation skills from a free online course and from a student club at university.

Thirdly, soft skills bring many benefits in study and work. Students with good soft skills can work well in groups and learn faster. A good example is my team at work, where good communication helps doctors and engineers understand each other.

Another important point is that soft skills improve our personal relationships. Good listening and communication help us avoid arguments with family and friends. For example, when I listen carefully to my parents, we understand each other better.

To sum up, soft skills are very important in modern life. We can learn them in many places, and they help us in study, work and personal life.
follow_ups: People can learn soft skills in many places. The easiest way is to join clubs and volunteer activities at school or university. In addition, many companies offer training courses for their staff. We can also watch free videos online and practise the skills every day.

No, I do not think so. Young people are good at technology, but many of them spend too much time on their phones. For example, some students find it hard to talk face to face or solve problems without the Internet. However, they can learn new skills very quickly.

In my opinion, communication is the most important soft skill nowadays. The main reason is that almost every job needs teamwork. For example, in my work, I have to explain AI tools clearly to doctors who are not experts in technology. Without good communication, even a great idea cannot succeed.

2.answer:
Nowadays, clean water is becoming harder to find in many regions because there are more people, more pollution and a changing climate. This essay will discuss the main solutions to this problem. In my opinion, the most effective ones involve farmers and governments.

To begin with, individuals can save water in two ways. Firstly, people can change their daily habits at home. They can turn off the tap while brushing their teeth and take shorter showers. For example, my family keeps the water used for washing vegetables to water our plants. Secondly, people can fix leaks and use water-saving devices. This is because a small leak can waste a lot of water over a month. As a result, families save water and also pay lower bills.

In addition, farmers and governments also play an important role. One important point is that farmers should use modern watering methods. Farming uses a large amount of fresh water, so small changes can save a lot. For instance, drip irrigation brings water directly to the roots of plants and wastes very little. Another point is that governments should protect water sources and charge more for heavy use. Rivers and lakes supply water to cities, so they must be kept clean. A good example is a higher water price for factories and families that use too much. Thanks to this, people think more carefully before they waste water.

In conclusion, saving fresh water needs effort from both individuals and society. In my opinion, the most effective ways are modern watering methods in farming and fair water prices because they save the most water. However, small habits at home are also important.

Today I would like to talk about the impact of social media on modern life. In my opinion, social media is a powerful tool, but we need to use it wisely.

Firstly, social media brings many benefits. It helps us keep in touch with friends, get news quickly and learn new things. For example, I follow several pages about health and technology, and they help me update my knowledge every day.

Secondly, social media also has negative effects. Many people spend too many hours scrolling, and some believe fake news without checking it. For instance, during the COVID-19 pandemic, a lot of wrong health advice spread quickly on Facebook.

Thirdly, we should learn how to use social media responsibly. We can limit our screen time, check information before sharing it and be polite in our comments. A good example is my habit of turning off notifications after 10 p.m. so that I can sleep well.

Another important point is that social media helps people support each other in difficult times. Charity groups can ask for help and raise money very quickly. For example, after big floods in central Vietnam, many people sent food and money through online groups.

To sum up, social media has both benefits and negative effects, so we should use it responsibly and for good purposes.
3.own_idea: Social media helps people support each other in difficult times
follow_ups: Social media has made communication faster and cheaper. We can send messages and photos or make video calls to anyone in seconds. For example, I talk to my uncle in Germany on Zalo every week for free. However, many people now talk less face to face.

Yes, I think parents should control their children's use of social media. Young children cannot always tell what is safe or true online. For example, parents can set time limits and check which apps their children use. As children grow older, parents can give them more freedom.

Yes, I think social media will become even more important. More people will use it for shopping, studying and working. For example, many small shops already sell most of their products through livestreams. In the future, AI will also make these platforms smarter and more personal.

2.answer:
People have different opinions on whether computers and apps are better than classroom lessons for learning English and other foreign languages. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that technology is very helpful for language learners.

On the one hand, some people believe that traditional methods are still necessary. This is because a real teacher can correct mistakes and keep students motivated. Learners can also practise speaking face to face with their classmates. For example, in a classroom, a teacher can hear a student's wrong pronunciation and help him fix it immediately. As a result, many learners still feel that they make faster progress with a teacher and classmates.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that technology brings many advantages to language learning. Firstly, it allows people to learn at any time and in any place. Learners only need a smartphone and an Internet connection. For instance, a busy office worker can practise vocabulary with an app like Duolingo on the bus to work. Many apps also send reminders, so learners study a little every day. Secondly, technology gives learners a lot of real English. This means that they can hear how native speakers talk in daily life. A good example is watching English films with subtitles or listening to English podcasts while cooking. Therefore, learners can improve their listening and speaking skills in a natural and enjoyable way.

In conclusion, although traditional classes still help learners with feedback and motivation, I believe that technology is very useful because it is flexible and offers a lot of real English. In my view, the best way is to combine both methods.

Today I would like to talk about childhood obesity and solutions to reduce it. In my opinion, this is a serious health problem that needs attention from everyone.

Firstly, the main causes of childhood obesity are an unhealthy diet and a lack of exercise. Many children often eat fast food and spend hours on phones instead of playing outside. For example, my nephew often has fried chicken and milk tea after school.

Secondly, obesity has negative effects on children's physical and mental health. Overweight children have a higher risk of diabetes and heart disease later in life. For instance, some overweight children are teased by their classmates, so they feel shy and lose confidence.

Thirdly, families, schools and society all need to offer solutions. Parents should cook healthy meals, and schools should provide healthier lunches and more sports. A good example of what society can do is to limit advertisements for sweet snacks on children's TV programmes.

Another important point is that regular health check-ups can find the problem early. Doctors can check children's weight and give advice to parents before it becomes serious. As someone who studied medicine, I know that early help is much easier and more effective.

To sum up, childhood obesity has clear causes and serious effects, but families, schools, society and doctors can work together to reduce it.
3.own_idea: Regular health check-ups find the problem early
follow_ups: I think it is becoming serious because children's lifestyles have changed. Fast food and sweet drinks are cheap and easy to buy everywhere. At the same time, children spend more time on screens and less time playing outside. For example, many city children have no space to play near their homes.

Parents should be good role models for their children. They should cook healthy meals at home and buy fewer sweet snacks and soft drinks. For example, families can go for a walk or ride bikes together at weekends. Parents should also limit their children's screen time.

Yes, I think schools should play a bigger role. Children spend most of the day at school, so school meals and activities are very important. For example, schools can serve more vegetables and fruit and have more sports lessons. They can also teach students about healthy eating.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many people have busy lives and talk to their friends mostly through screens, so close friendships are harder to keep. However, friends are still very important to us. This essay will discuss the main benefits of friendship and how people can keep good friends.

To begin with, friendship helps individuals in two important ways. Firstly, good friends give us emotional support when we have problems. We can share our worries with them, and they listen without judging us. For example, when I failed an important exam at medical school, my best friend stayed with me and helped me study again. Secondly, friends help us enjoy life and grow as people. This is because we share new experiences and learn from each other. As a result, people with close friends are often happier and more confident.

In addition, there are two simple ways to build and maintain good friendships. One important point is that people should spend real time together. Online messages are useful, but face-to-face meetings make friendships much stronger. For instance, my friends and I meet at a coffee shop every Saturday afternoon, even when we are busy. Another point is that friends need to be honest and supportive. They should keep their promises and help each other in difficult times. A good example is helping a friend move house or visiting him in hospital. Thanks to this, trust grows, and the friendship can last for many years.

In conclusion, friendship is very important because it gives us emotional support and makes our lives happier. To build and keep good friendships, people should spend time together and always be honest and supportive.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the importance of learning history. In my opinion, history is not only about dates and names, but also about understanding who we are.

Firstly, history helps us understand the past and important events. We can learn how our country was built and why our society is the way it is today. For example, when students learn about the 30th of April 1975, they understand why Reunification Day is a national holiday.

Secondly, we can learn lessons from historical experiences. If we know the mistakes of the past, we can avoid repeating them. For instance, history shows that wars bring great pain, so people today value peace more.

Thirdly, learning history develops our cultural awareness and identity. It helps us understand our traditions and feel proud of our roots. A good example is the Hung Kings' Commemoration Day, which reminds Vietnamese people of their origins.

Another important point is that history improves our critical thinking. Students have to compare different sources and ask why events happened. For example, when we read two different stories about one event, we learn to check the facts carefully.

To sum up, learning history is important because it helps us understand the past, learn lessons, build our identity and think critically.
follow_ups: Young people should learn history because they are the future of the country. Knowing the past helps them understand their duties today. For example, when students visit the Cu Chi Tunnels, they see how hard life was for the older generation. This makes them value peace more.

No, I do not think history is more important than other subjects. Every subject has its own value. For example, maths helps us think logically, while science helps us understand the world. However, history should still receive enough attention in schools.

Teachers can use stories, films and field trips instead of only asking students to remember dates. Students remember events better when they can see and feel them. For example, a class trip to the War Remnants Museum can be more memorable than a long lecture. Group projects and quizzes also help.
