2.answer:
People have different opinions on whether school leavers should spend a year working, travelling or volunteering before they go to university. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that a well-planned gap year can be very useful.

On the one hand, some people believe that students should start university right after high school. This is because they are used to studying, and a long break may make it hard to return. For example, a young person who works for a year and earns money may not want to go back to school. As a result, he may never get a degree, or he may graduate a year later than his friends.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that a gap year brings real benefits. Firstly, it gives young people practical experience and useful life skills. They can work, volunteer or travel and learn to look after themselves. For instance, a student who works at a hotel for a year learns to communicate, manage money and solve problems. Secondly, a gap year helps students discover what they really want to study. This means that they are less likely to choose the wrong major. A good example is a friend of mine who planned to study business. After volunteering at a hospital for a year, she chose nursing instead. Therefore, students who take a gap year often study with more motivation.

In conclusion, although a gap year may delay students' studies, I believe that it is a good idea because it builds life skills and helps them choose the right major. However, students should plan the year carefully so that they do not waste it.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of studying abroad. In my opinion, studying in another country is a great experience that can change a young person's life.

Firstly, students can make international friends and experience different cultures. They study and live with people from many countries, so they learn new ways of thinking. For example, my cousin studied in Australia, and her classmates came from Japan, India and Brazil.

Secondly, students can improve their English skills through daily communication. They have to use English when they go shopping, take the bus or talk with teachers. For instance, after one year abroad, my cousin could speak English much more naturally and confidently.

Thirdly, studying abroad gives students more career opportunities in the future. Many companies want employees with an international degree and good language skills. A good example is a colleague of mine who studied in Singapore and now leads an international research project.

Another important point is that studying abroad helps young people become more independent. They must cook, manage money and solve problems without their parents. For example, many students learn to cook simple meals and plan their own budget in their first month.

To sum up, studying abroad has many benefits because of international friends, better English, more career opportunities and greater independence.
follow_ups: No, I do not think it is always better. Studying abroad gives students more international experience, but it is very expensive. For example, many good universities in Vietnam now offer international programmes at a lower cost. So the best choice depends on each student's goals and budget.

Students can face many challenges when they study abroad. The biggest one is feeling homesick and lonely, especially in the first months. For example, they may miss their family and Vietnamese food during Tet. Language problems and high living costs can also make life difficult.

People should prepare carefully before they go. First, they need to improve their English and learn about the culture of the new country. For example, they can join online groups of Vietnamese students there to ask for advice. They should also plan their budget and buy health insurance.

2.answer:
Nowadays, it is common for university students to work a few hours a week while they study, for example in cafés or as private tutors. Although some people believe that this can harm their studies, I agree that students should take part-time jobs.

Admittedly, some people argue that working can hurt students' academic results. This is because a job takes time and energy that students need for studying. For example, a student who works late at a restaurant may feel too tired to attend a morning class. As a result, his marks may go down, and he may even fail some exams.

However, I firmly believe that university students should do part-time jobs for two main reasons. Firstly, working gives students real experience and useful skills. They learn how to communicate with customers, solve problems and work in a team. For instance, a student who works in a coffee shop learns to stay calm and polite when many customers are waiting. Secondly, a part-time job helps students become more independent. The reason is that they earn their own money and learn how to manage it. A good example is my own experience as a medical student, when I taught biology to high school students at weekends. With that money, I paid for my own books. Therefore, students who work are often more mature and better prepared for their future careers.

In conclusion, although part-time jobs may take some time away from studying, I believe that students should do them because they gain useful skills and become more independent. However, they should work only a few hours a week so that their studies always come first.

In this situation, among the three options, I think meeting and talking with friends to learn more about local life is the best choice. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that local friends can show me the real Singapore. By that, I mean they know places and habits that are not in travel guides. For example, my friend Wei, who lives in Singapore, could take me to a hawker centre and tell me which dishes local people love. I could also learn why people there are so careful about keeping the city clean.

Another reason is that talking with friends is a good chance to practise English and build friendships. In other words, I can learn about the culture and improve my speaking at the same time. For instance, we could talk about work, family and food over coffee for a whole afternoon.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding reading books in a library, I do not think it is the best choice because I can read books at home in Vietnam. As for exploring information and places through the Internet, I do not think it is the best option either because online information is often general and not very personal.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe meeting local friends is the best choice because it is real, interesting and meaningful.

Today I would like to talk about the importance of becoming a young leader. In my opinion, young people should start learning to lead early because society needs their energy and new ideas.

Firstly, a good young leader needs some important qualities. He or she should be responsible, honest and a good listener. For example, the leader of a student club should listen to every member before making a decision.

Secondly, young leadership brings many benefits to society. Young leaders often understand new technology and the needs of other young people. For instance, many student volunteer groups in Ho Chi Minh City use social media to organise blood donation events.

Thirdly, there are many ways to develop leadership skills. Young people can join clubs, volunteer groups or school projects and take small responsibilities first. A good example is that I led a small health project as a medical student, and I learned a lot from it.

Another important point is that young leaders can inspire others. When students see someone of their age leading successfully, they believe that they can do it too. For example, a young team leader at my university has encouraged many junior researchers to share their ideas.

To sum up, becoming a young leader is important because it builds good qualities, helps society, develops useful skills and inspires others.
follow_ups: Leadership skills are important because they help young people in study, work and life. A leader must plan, communicate and solve problems. For example, students who lead group projects often find it easier to get a job later. These skills also make them more confident.

Yes, I think most people can become good leaders. Leadership is not only a gift but also a skill that we can learn. For instance, a shy student can become a confident leader after years of practice in clubs. However, it needs time and hard work.

I think young people should start with small roles. They can lead a group project, join a volunteer club or organise a class event. For example, my younger brother organised a charity trip for his class last year. He learned how to plan, share tasks and deal with problems.

2.answer:
Nowadays, traditional dishes are still a key part of culture and everyday life in Vietnam and many other countries. People love them, but they can also cause some difficulties. This essay will discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of local food.

On the one hand, local food has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that some traditional dishes can be bad for our health. This is because many of them contain a lot of salt, fat or sugar, and some street stalls are not very clean. For example, pickled vegetables and many fried snacks are very salty or oily, and many people eat them almost every day. As a result, these people may slowly get high blood pressure or stomach problems.

On the other hand, local food brings two important benefits. Firstly, it helps to protect a country's culture and bring people together. The reason is that traditional dishes are often cooked for family meals and festivals. For instance, during Tet, many Vietnamese families make banh chung together and share it with their relatives. Secondly, local food supports the local economy. This means that it creates jobs for small sellers and attracts many tourists. A good example is Hoi An, where visitors from all over the world come to try cao lau and banh mi in small family restaurants. Thanks to this, many local families can earn a stable income.

In conclusion, local food has both advantages and disadvantages. Some dishes may harm our health, but local food keeps our culture alive and helps local people earn money. Therefore, we should keep enjoying traditional dishes, but we should choose clean places and eat them in moderation.

The main advantage is that pets make us happy and reduce stress. However, they need a lot of time and money. For example, I have to clean my cat's litter box every day and sometimes take her to the vet.

Eating more vegetables and sleeping enough are very helpful habits. They keep our body strong and our mind clear. For example, walking for thirty minutes a day can lower the risk of heart disease.

Today I would like to talk about ways to stay healthy. In my opinion, good health comes from simple daily habits.

Firstly, we should maintain a balanced diet. Our body needs vegetables, fruit, protein and a little healthy fat every day. For example, I try to fill half of my plate with vegetables, and I drink water instead of soft drinks.

Secondly, doing regular exercise and physical activities keeps our body strong. It helps us control our weight and protects our heart. For instance, I go swimming every weekend, and on weekdays I take the stairs instead of the lift.

Thirdly, it is important to take care of our mental health and reduce stress. Too much stress can cause headaches, poor sleep and even heart problems. A good example is my habit of meeting friends at a coffee shop on Sundays, which helps me relax after a busy week.

Another important point is that we need to get enough sleep. Adults should sleep about seven to eight hours a night so that the body can recover. As someone who studied medicine, I know that people who sleep too little get sick more easily.

To sum up, we can stay healthy with simple daily habits like a balanced diet, regular exercise, less stress and enough sleep.
follow_ups: I think the main reason is that modern life is very busy. Many people work long hours, so they have little time to cook or exercise. For example, my colleagues often eat instant noodles at their desks. Fast food is also cheap and easy to find everywhere.

Technology plays a helpful role in staying healthy. Smartphones and smartwatches can count our steps and check our sleep. For instance, I use an app that reminds me to drink water and stand up every hour. In my job, AI also helps doctors find diseases earlier.

Yes, I think so. Children learn their eating and exercise habits when they are young. For example, schools can teach students how to read food labels and cook simple healthy meals. If they learn this early, they will stay healthier as adults.

2.answer:
Nowadays, millions of people meet new friends through apps such as Facebook and Instagram instead of in real life. Some see this as a positive change, but others are worried about it. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, making friends online has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that people may not be who they say they are. This is because anyone can use a fake name and a fake photo on the Internet. For example, a teenager may chat with a new online friend for months and then be asked to send money. As a result, online friendships can be dangerous, especially for young people who trust others too easily.

On the other hand, making friends online brings two important benefits. Firstly, it helps people find friends with the same interests. The reason is that there are online groups for almost every hobby. For instance, I joined a Facebook group for book lovers, and now I meet some members at a coffee shop every month. Secondly, it allows people to make friends from other countries. This means that they can learn about new cultures and practise foreign languages. A good example is a student in Da Nang who chats in English with a Japanese friend every week. Thanks to this, both of them improve their English and understand each other's culture better.

In conclusion, making friends online has both advantages and disadvantages. It can be risky because of fake profiles, but it also connects people with similar hobbies and with people from other countries. Therefore, users should enjoy online friendships but always be careful with strangers.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of doing sports. In my opinion, everyone should do some sport because it is good for both the body and the mind.

Firstly, sports help us improve our physical health and maintain a healthy lifestyle. When we exercise regularly, our heart and muscles become stronger. For example, I go swimming every weekend, and I rarely catch a cold now.

Secondly, doing sports reduces stress and improves our mental well-being. During exercise, our body produces chemicals that make us feel happy and relaxed. For instance, after a long week at work, a swim on Saturday morning always makes me feel calm again.

Thirdly, team sports help people develop teamwork and social skills. Players must talk, listen and support each other to win a match. A good example is my office football team, whose members play every Thursday evening and now work together much better.

Another important point is that sports teach us discipline. To get better, we need to practise at fixed times and follow clear rules. For example, a young badminton player has to train hard even when he feels lazy.

To sum up, doing sports has many benefits because of better physical health, less stress, stronger teamwork and more discipline. I hope more people will make sport a part of their daily life.
follow_ups: Football is the most popular sport in Vietnam. Many people play it with friends after work, and millions watch the national team on TV. Badminton and swimming are also very common. For example, in my neighbourhood, many older people play badminton in the park every morning.

Many people find it difficult because they are too busy. They work long hours and feel tired in the evening. For example, many office workers in big cities spend two hours a day in traffic. In addition, there are not many cheap sports facilities near their homes.

I think having a friend to exercise with is the best motivation. When we make a plan with someone, we are less likely to give up. For example, I always go swimming with my friend on Sunday mornings. Setting small goals and seeing good results also helps a lot.

2.answer:
In recent years, rivers, lakes and seas in many countries have become dirty and unsafe. Most of this damage comes from people, farms and factories. This essay will discuss the main causes of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main causes of water pollution. Firstly, many factories release dirty water into rivers without treating it. This is because cleaning waste water is expensive, so some companies try to save money. For example, a factory may secretly pump chemicals into a nearby river at night. As a result, fish die and people who live nearby cannot use the water. Secondly, households and farms also pollute water every day. Many people throw plastic bags into canals, and many farmers use too many chemicals on their fields. For instance, after heavy rain, fertiliser from rice fields flows into rivers and lakes. Therefore, the water becomes green and smelly.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, governments should make stricter laws for factories. Every factory should have a system to clean its waste water, and inspectors should check it regularly. For instance, factories that break the rules should pay heavy fines or close until they fix the problem. Secondly, local authorities and schools should change people's daily habits. They can provide more rubbish bins and teach residents not to throw waste into canals. A good example is a training class that shows farmers how to use natural fertiliser instead of chemicals. Thanks to this, rivers and canals in both cities and the countryside will become cleaner.

In conclusion, water pollution is mainly caused by factory waste and careless habits in homes and on farms. However, this problem can be reduced if governments control factories strictly and local authorities help people change their daily habits.

The first reason is that time management helps students study better. By that, I mean they can plan their lessons, homework and revision, so they do not have to study at the last minute. For example, a student who makes a weekly study plan will feel much less stressed before exams.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of learning a new language. In my opinion, a new language opens many doors in our lives.

Firstly, learning a new language improves our communication skills and helps us connect with more people. We can talk to people from other countries and make friends with them. For example, thanks to English, I can chat with foreign researchers at international conferences.

Secondly, a new language helps us understand different cultures and perspectives. When we learn a language, we also learn how its speakers think and live. For instance, by watching English films, I have learnt a lot about the habits and humour of British people.

Thirdly, a new language creates better opportunities for study and work. Many good scholarships and jobs require a foreign language certificate. A good example is my friend, who got a job at a Japanese company because she spoke Japanese well.

Another important point is that learning a new language keeps our brain active. Learning new words and grammar is good exercise for the brain. With my medical background, I know that this kind of mental exercise is good for our memory.

To sum up, learning a new language is very useful because of better communication, cultural understanding, more opportunities and a healthier brain. Everyone should try to learn at least one foreign language.
follow_ups: Many people want to learn a new language to get a better job or study abroad. Others want to travel and talk to local people. For example, many Vietnamese students learn English or Korean to apply for scholarships. Some people simply love the films or music of another country.

I think the best way is to practise a little every day. Learners should use the language in real situations, not only study grammar. For example, they can watch films with subtitles, read short news articles and talk with native speakers online. Regular practice is more important than long lessons.

Yes, I think children should start early. Young children learn new sounds and words very quickly and naturally. For example, many children who learn English at kindergarten have better pronunciation than adults. However, learning should be fun so that they do not feel pressured.

2.answer:
In recent years, cheap and trendy clothes have become very popular, especially among young shoppers. However, the fast fashion industry is causing serious harm to both people and the planet. This essay will discuss the main problems of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main problems caused by fast fashion. Firstly, it creates a huge amount of waste and pollution. Because clothes are so cheap, people often wear them only a few times and then throw them away. For example, many T-shirts end up in landfills after just one season. As a result, the soil and water near these places become polluted. Secondly, fast fashion is often unfair to garment workers. This is because companies want to produce clothes as cheaply and quickly as possible. For instance, many factory workers have to work long hours for very low pay. Therefore, they have little time for rest and for their families.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, consumers and companies should reduce clothing waste. People can buy fewer but better clothes, and shops can collect old clothes for recycling. A good example is a shop that gives customers a discount when they bring back used clothes. Secondly, governments should protect garment workers more strictly. They should check factories regularly and punish companies that break labour laws. Brands should also tell customers where and how their clothes are made. Thanks to this, workers can have safer jobs and fairer wages.

In conclusion, fast fashion leads to serious waste and unfair working conditions. However, this problem can be reduced if consumers and companies cut clothing waste and governments protect the rights of garment workers.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of travelling. In my opinion, travelling is one of the best ways to learn and enjoy life.

Firstly, travelling helps us learn about different cultures. We can see how people in other places live, eat and celebrate. For example, when I visited Hue, I learnt a lot about its royal history and tried many special dishes.

Secondly, travelling helps us make new friends and expand our relationships. On a trip, we often talk to local people and other travellers. For instance, on a tour in Sa Pa, I met a couple from Australia, and we still keep in touch on Facebook.

Thirdly, travelling can reduce stress and improve our mental health. A new place takes us away from work and daily problems. A good example is my last beach trip, when I swam every morning and slept much better.

Another important point is that travelling helps us improve our language skills. When we travel abroad or meet foreign tourists, we have to speak English. For example, during a trip to Singapore, I asked for directions and ordered food in English every day.

To sum up, travelling has many benefits because of learning about cultures, making new friends, reducing stress and improving language skills. Everyone should try to travel at least once a year.
follow_ups: Many people enjoy travelling nowadays because it is cheaper and easier than before. There are many low-cost flights and booking apps. For example, I can book a flight and a hotel in Da Nang on my phone in ten minutes. Social media photos also encourage people to travel more.

I think travelling is beneficial for both, but in different ways. Young people can learn new things and become more confident. Older people can relax and enjoy their free time after many years of work. For example, my parents love short trips to the beach with their friends.

People can travel cheaply by planning carefully. They should book tickets early and travel outside the holiday season. For example, a trip to Da Lat in a normal week costs much less than during Tet. Staying in homestays and eating local food also saves money.

2.answer:
In recent years, many regions have not had enough clean water for drinking, farming and industry. This problem is becoming more serious every year. This essay will discuss the main causes of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main causes of water shortages. Firstly, people use too much water in their homes and on their farms. Many families leave taps running, and many farmers still flood their fields with water. For example, a lot of clean water is wasted when old pipes in cities leak for months. As a result, rivers and underground water are used up faster than nature can refill them. Secondly, climate change is making droughts longer and more frequent. This means that there is less rain to fill rivers and lakes. For instance, in the dry season, salt water often enters rivers in the Mekong Delta. Therefore, farmers cannot use the water for their rice fields.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, governments and water companies should help people use water more carefully. They can repair old pipes and run campaigns to teach people how to save water. A good example is a school programme that teaches children to turn off the tap while brushing their teeth. Secondly, governments should help farmers prepare for droughts. They should build more reservoirs to store rainwater and support farmers to use drip irrigation. For example, coffee farmers in the Central Highlands can water their plants with much less water. Thanks to this, there will be enough water during the dry season.

In conclusion, water shortages are mainly caused by wasteful use and climate change. However, this problem can be reduced if governments help people save water and support farmers to store water for the dry season.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the effect of parenting on children's development. In my opinion, parents have the biggest influence on who their children become.

Firstly, parents play an important role in children's personality development. Children copy what their parents say and do every day. For example, if parents are kind and patient, their children often learn to be kind and patient too.

Secondly, parenting affects children's education and behaviour. Parents who care about learning usually help their children build good study habits. For instance, my parents read books with me every evening, so I started to love reading when I was very young.

Thirdly, communication between parents and children is very important. When children can talk openly with their parents, they feel safe and loved. A good example is a teenager who tells his parents about problems at school instead of hiding them.

Another important point is that parents should take care of their children's physical health. Healthy food, enough sleep and regular exercise help children grow and learn better. With my medical background, I know that many children today eat too much fast food and sit in front of screens all day.

To sum up, parenting affects children's personality, education, behaviour and health. Parents should spend time with their children and set a good example for them.
follow_ups: I think the most effective style is a balance between love and clear rules. Children need warmth, but they also need limits. For example, parents can be friendly and still ask children to finish their homework before playing games. This helps children feel safe and responsible.

I think parents should focus on both, but emotional support comes first. Children who feel loved are more likely to follow rules. For instance, a child who is praised for small efforts will try harder next time. Discipline works better when it comes with kindness.

Parents can help children become independent by giving them small tasks at home. For example, children can make their beds, prepare their school bags or help with cooking. Parents should also let children make simple choices and learn from their mistakes. This builds their confidence step by step.

2.answer:
Today, students can find almost any lesson on the Internet, from free videos to paid online courses. People have different opinions on whether printed textbooks are still necessary in this digital age. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that textbooks remain very useful.

On the one hand, some people believe that textbooks are becoming less important. This is because online materials are richer, newer and often free. For example, a student can watch a short and clear video about chemistry on YouTube instead of reading a long chapter. Students can also watch these lessons again and again at any time. As a result, many young people rarely open their textbooks at home.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that textbooks still play an important role. Firstly, textbooks give students a clear and reliable structure for learning. They are written by experts and follow the national curriculum, so the information is checked carefully. In contrast, a lot of information online is out of date or even wrong. For instance, a grade 12 student can use the textbook to know exactly what the final exam will cover. Secondly, textbooks help students focus better than screens. This means that students are not distracted by games, messages or advertisements. A good example is my younger cousin, who often stops studying online to watch TikTok videos for a long time. Therefore, textbooks are still a safe and effective learning tool.

In conclusion, although online materials are rich and convenient, I believe that textbooks are still important because they are reliable and help students focus. The best way is to use textbooks together with good digital resources.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits and trends of staying at home for holidays. In my opinion, a stay-at-home holiday can be just as enjoyable as a trip.

Firstly, staying at home helps people save money and reduce travel costs. They do not have to pay for plane tickets, hotels or expensive meals in tourist areas. For example, during the last Tet holiday, my family stayed at home and saved a lot of money.

Secondly, people can spend more time with their family. When we travel, we are often busy with moving from place to place. For instance, last holiday I cooked with my mother and played board games with my nephews every evening.

Thirdly, a holiday at home gives us a relaxing and flexible schedule. We can sleep late, read books or meet friends whenever we like. A good example is my last holiday, when I read two novels and swam at the local pool.

Another important point is that staying at home helps us avoid crowds and traffic jams. During public holidays, roads, airports and beaches are often very crowded. This can make a trip tiring and stressful instead of relaxing.

To sum up, staying at home for holidays is becoming popular because it saves money, brings families closer and gives us more freedom. It is a good choice for busy people who need a real rest.

Yes, I think stay-at-home holidays will become more popular. Travel prices are going up, and many people work very hard. For example, many of my colleagues say they just want to sleep and watch films during holidays. Online entertainment also makes staying at home more fun.

The main disadvantage is that holidays at home can be boring. People do not see new places or try new things. Some people also keep checking work emails because they are at home. As a result, they do not feel that they have a real break.

2.answer:
Nowadays, in many homes, cooking, cleaning and washing are done by all family members rather than by the mother alone. Many people think that this is a very positive change. This essay will discuss the main benefits of this.

To begin with, sharing housework helps individuals in two ways. Firstly, it reduces stress for the person who used to do everything. This is because one person no longer has to cook, clean and look after the children after a long working day. For example, a working mother can have time to rest or read a book in the evening. Secondly, children learn useful life skills when they help at home. For instance, a teenager who often cooks with his parents will be able to look after himself at university. As a result, young people become more independent and responsible.

In addition, sharing housework also helps families. One important point is that family members spend more time together. When parents and children cook or clean together, they can talk and laugh at the same time. A good example is my own family, who clean the house together every Sunday morning while listening to music. Another point is that sharing chores makes the family fairer and happier. The reason is that everyone feels respected when the work is divided equally. Thanks to this, there are fewer arguments between husbands and wives, and children see a good model of a happy family.

In conclusion, sharing household chores benefits both individuals and families in many ways. It reduces stress and teaches children life skills, and it also brings family members closer and creates a fairer home.

In this situation, among the three options, I think trying a new sport is the best choice for my friend. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that sport is very good for mental health. By that, I mean exercise helps the body produce chemicals that make us feel happier and calmer. For example, with my medical background, I know that doctors often advise stressed patients to exercise regularly. Even a short game in the evening can improve our mood.

Another reason is that a new sport helps my friend forget about his problems. In other words, he has to focus on learning new movements, so he has no time to worry. For instance, he can join a badminton club near his house and play with new people every evening. He may also make some new friends there.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding learning a new skill, I do not think it is the best choice because it can create more pressure. He may feel worse if he learns slowly. As for taking part in volunteer activities, I do not think it is the best option either because volunteer work can be tiring and emotional. He should take care of himself first.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe trying a new sport is the best choice because it is healthy, fun and relaxing.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of owning a personal car. In my opinion, a car can make our daily lives much easier.

Firstly, a car is convenient for long-distance travel. People can drive to other cities whenever they want without buying bus or train tickets. For example, my family often drives from Ho Chi Minh City to Da Lat during the holidays.

Secondly, a car gives us protection from bad weather. In Vietnam, it often rains heavily in the rainy season, and the sun is very strong in summer. For instance, when I ride my motorbike in the rain, I usually get wet, but in a car I stay dry.

Thirdly, a car offers greater comfort and flexibility. We can sit in a cool seat, listen to music and choose our own route and time. A good example is a parent who can take the children to school and then go to work in one trip.

Another important point is that a car is safer for families with young children or elderly people. They are protected by seat belts and do not have to stand on crowded buses. This is very helpful when someone in the family is sick and needs to see a doctor.

To sum up, owning a car has many benefits because of long-distance travel, protection from bad weather, comfort and safety. However, we should still use it wisely to reduce traffic and pollution.
follow_ups: In the 20th century, very few Vietnamese families had cars, and most people used bicycles or motorbikes. In the 21st century, the number of cars has increased very quickly. This is because people's incomes are higher and car loans are easier to get.

Yes, I think the number of cars will continue to increase. More families can afford a car as the economy grows. However, people may use electric cars instead of petrol cars. For example, Vietnamese electric car brands like VinFast are becoming more popular.

Personal cars affect people's lives in both good and bad ways. They make travel faster, safer and more comfortable. On the other hand, they cause traffic jams and air pollution. For example, many roads in Ho Chi Minh City are full of cars during rush hour.

2.answer:
In recent years, cities have become much brighter at night because of street lights, advertising signs and tall office buildings. However, this artificial light is not always harmless. This essay will discuss the main problems of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main problems caused by light pollution. Firstly, it harms people's health, especially their sleep. This is because bright light at night tells our brain that it is still daytime. For example, many people who live next to large advertising screens find it hard to fall asleep. As a result, they feel tired the next day and may have headaches. Secondly, light pollution confuses wild animals. Many birds and insects use natural light from the moon and stars to find their way. For instance, baby sea turtles may walk towards hotel lights instead of the sea. Therefore, many of them die before they reach the water.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, city governments should control outdoor lighting more strictly. They can ask shops to turn off advertising signs after 11 p.m. and use street lights that point downwards. At home, people can also use thick curtains to sleep better. Secondly, hotels and building owners near beaches and parks should reduce their lights at night. The reason is that dark areas are important for wildlife. A good example is a beach hotel that turns off its garden lights during the turtle season. Thanks to this, animals can live and move more safely.

In conclusion, light pollution harms people's sleep and confuses wild animals. However, this problem can be reduced if city governments control outdoor lighting and buildings near beaches and parks turn off unnecessary lights at night.

Today I would like to talk about responsibility as a key factor for a successful life. In my opinion, responsible people are more likely to succeed and be happy.

Firstly, we should have responsibility toward our family and society. A responsible person takes care of his family and follows the rules of the community. For example, my father always works hard to support us, and he also helps to clean our neighbourhood.

Secondly, responsibility in study and work is very important. Responsible students and workers finish their tasks on time and do them carefully. For instance, in my research team, I always check our medical data twice before I send it to doctors.

Thirdly, there are many benefits of being responsible. People trust responsible people, so they get more chances in life. A good example is a colleague of mine who was promoted because she never missed a deadline.

Another important point is that responsibility helps us become more independent. When we take responsibility for our own choices, we stop blaming other people. As a result, we learn from our mistakes and grow up faster.

To sum up, responsibility is important because it helps us care for others, do well at school and work, and earn people's trust. Everyone should try to be a little more responsible every day.
follow_ups: Responsibility is important because modern life is busy and complicated. People depend on each other at work and in society. For example, if one worker in a hospital is careless, a patient may get the wrong medicine. So everyone must do their job responsibly.

No, I do not think so. A person may be successful for a short time without responsibility, but not for long. For instance, a businessman who cheats his customers will lose their trust. In the end, his business will fail.

Schools can give students real tasks and let them take care of them. For example, students can take turns cleaning the classroom or leading a group project. Teachers should also praise students who keep their promises. This helps them learn responsibility step by step.

Dear Alex,

Thank you for your email. I am happy to answer your questions about my work.

Regarding my job, I am now a researcher at a university in Ho Chi Minh City. My team builds AI tools that help doctors and patients. My main tasks are collecting medical data, testing our tools and writing reports. I studied medicine before, so I often explain medical problems to the engineers in my team.

As for my best project, last year we finished an AI app that reads chest X-rays. It helps doctors find lung problems faster. I worked closely with doctors at a big hospital for six months to test it. Now three hospitals in the city use it every day.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many tourist cities are building more hotels, roads and attractions to welcome visitors from home and abroad. Tourism has become a main source of income for these places, but it also brings some problems. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, tourism development has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that it can damage the environment and the daily life of local people. This is because large numbers of tourists create more rubbish, noise and traffic. For example, some beaches in Nha Trang become crowded and dirty during the summer holidays. The prices of food and housing may also go up quickly. As a result, local people may feel that their city is no longer a pleasant place to live.

On the other hand, tourism development brings two important benefits. Firstly, it creates many jobs for local people. Hotels, restaurants and tour companies need a lot of staff all year round. For instance, many young people in Hoi An work as tour guides or waiters, so they do not have to move to big cities. Secondly, tourism helps cities improve their infrastructure. The reason is that money from tourists can be used to build better roads, airports and parks. A good example is Da Nang, which now has modern bridges and a clean, beautiful beach area. Thanks to this, local people also enjoy a better quality of life.

In conclusion, tourism development has both advantages and disadvantages. It may harm the environment and local life, but it also creates jobs and better infrastructure. Therefore, local governments should plan tourism carefully to protect their cities.

2.answer:
In this situation, among the three options, I think talking to the neighbors directly is the best choice. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that a friendly talk can solve the problem quickly. By that, I mean my neighbor may not know that the noise is a problem for me. For example, I can visit him in the evening and politely explain that I need to sleep early for work. Most people will agree to turn down their music after a polite request.

Another reason is that this option keeps a good relationship between us. In other words, we will live next to each other for a long time, so we should stay friendly. For instance, if I need help one day, such as watering my plants during a trip, I can still ask him.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding moving to another place, I do not think it is the best choice because it costs a lot of money and time. I would also have to find a new home near my workplace. As for reporting the problem to the police, I do not think it is the best option either because it may make my neighbor angry. The police should only be the last choice.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe talking to the neighbors directly is the best choice because it is quick, cheap and friendly.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the reasons for divorce. In my opinion, there are several common reasons why many couples decide to separate.

Firstly, financial burden and economic problems can cause many arguments. When a family does not have enough money, both the husband and the wife feel stressed. For example, a couple may argue every month about how to pay the rent and the school fees.

Secondly, a lack of responsibility in family life can break a marriage. If one person does not share the housework or care for the children, the other person feels tired and alone. For instance, a wife who works full-time and also does all the housework may finally want a divorce.

Thirdly, communication problems between couples are a serious reason. Many couples are too busy to talk about their feelings, so small problems become big ones. A good example is a couple who only look at their phones during dinner.

Another important point is that different values and lifestyles can push couples apart. Some people get married too quickly before they really understand each other. Later, they find that they want very different things in life.

To sum up, divorce is often caused by money problems, a lack of responsibility, poor communication and different values. Couples should talk openly and support each other.
follow_ups: I think the divorce rate has increased because people's lives have changed. Today, many women have their own jobs and incomes, so they do not have to stay in an unhappy marriage. Also, society is more open about divorce than in the past.

No, I do not think financial problems are the main cause. They are important, but many poor couples still have happy marriages. In my opinion, poor communication is a bigger reason. For example, couples who cannot talk about money calmly will argue more often.

Couples can keep a healthy relationship by talking and listening to each other every day. They should also share housework and important decisions. For example, they can have dinner together without phones and talk about their day. Small things like this make the relationship stronger.
